headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs SPY YTD
summary: As of September 23, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 28.01% compared to SPY's 13.31%. This results in an average alpha of 14.70%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered a substantial return of 50.52%, significantly contributing to the overall outperformance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned 11.04%, highlighting a notable disparity within the portfolio set. Outperforming SPY during this period can signal resilience amid broader market conditions. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
